Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal.

GEORGE
(overcome with emotion)
I... I don't understand. I'm just a simple man from a small town. I've lived a long life, but this? It's just... it's just...

The officials and reporters erupt in applause as George is congratulated and interviewed.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, the gold medal and certificate displayed proudly on his nightstand. He looks up at the ceiling, a faraway look in his eyes.

GEORGE (V.O)
I remember reading about this theory when I was a young man. Quantum Immortality. It said that if you lived long enough, you would eventually find a way to cheat death. That the universe would create a reality where you survived.

George's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
I always thought it was just a silly idea, a fantasy. But now... now I'm not so sure.

Suddenly, George's expression changes. His eyes widen, and his face contorts in a mixture of fear and despair.

GEORGE (V.O)
What if it's true? What if I'm not just a record holder? What if I'm... I'm immortal?

George's voice rises to a fever pitch as he begins to pace back and forth across the room.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
I've lived for 127 years. I've seen empires rise and fall. I've watched as humanity has made progress and stumbled. And all the while, I've been... waiting. Waiting for the universe to create a reality where I could survive.

George's words become a mantra, repeating over and over in his mind.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
Quantum Immortality. It's not just a theory. It's a reality. And I'm the proof.

As the night wears on, George's mental state deteriorates further. He becomes convinced that he is the only one who truly understands the nature of reality.

GEORGE (V.O)
I'm the only one who knows the truth. I'm the only one who can see the threads that connect everything. And I'm the only one who can escape the cycle of death and rebirth.

George's voice drops to a whisper, and he begins to speak in a language that is almost incoherent.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
I'm not just a man. I'm a doorway. A doorway to the multiverse. And I'm the key.

As the camera zooms in on George's face, his eyes roll back in his head, and he collapses onto the bed, consumed by his own madness.

FADE TO BLACK.
